description: Test suite for JPEG transcoding functionalities in the OpenClawKit project, including image creation, compression, and resizing tests.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoderTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing methods to test JPEG transcoding functionalities, such as image resizing, orientation normalization, and byte size constraints.

methods.name: makeSolidJPEG
methods.description: Creates a solid-colored JPEG image with specified width, height, and optional orientation.

methods.name: makeNoiseJPEG
methods.description: Creates a JPEG image filled with random noise pixels with specified width and height.

methods.name: downscalesToMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test that verifies JPEGs are downscaled appropriately to a maximum width in pixels.

methods.name: doesNotUpscaleWhenSmallerThanMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test that verifies images smaller than max width are not upscaled.

methods.name: normalizesOrientationAndUsesOrientedWidthForMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test that verifies orientation normalization and width calculation when maxWidthPx is applied.

methods.name: respectsMaxBytes
methods.description: Test that verifies the JPEG output respects the maximum byte size limit.
